planets.name: K2-223 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-223 with a 4.56-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-223 c was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around K2-223. Its orbit and size follow Jankowski et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
